scope.maxInitialJudgments: 3840 retrieved memberships before deduplication, plus independently proposed eligible reference candidates
scope.representationRule: Pack-free embedded headers in both representations via public preparation. Parent-context adds approved bounded root excerpt; unchanged root/identity units retain existing vocabulary. Preserve previous receipts; reuse exact input hashes only.
scope.retrieval: Semantic-only complete eligible-unit scoring, root maximum, deterministic tie break; no lexical/exact tiers or fusion.

blind.reuseAcrossScopes: Only identical intent and applicable scope; preserve distinct observation memberships.
blind.source: Coordinator bound source path/hash once per ID in private manifest; reviewer evidence pointer/quote only.
blind.holdout: Open once only after runtime/corpus/representation/metric freeze; no policy or query adaptation.

grades.contradiction: Source-backed opposite function, separate from irrelevance; unresolved remains unknown.
grades.grade1: Substantively related but not useful, including opposite function; grade0 unrelated/coincidental.

secondary: Within-model paired context delta for each model
Equal-weight average context effect across four fixed models
Useful adjudicated known-reference full ranks and coverage, nonexhaustive
Discovery-only and name-control summaries; all24 remains primary
metrics.aggregate: Average filtered/open within each concept, then equal-weight concepts; also report each scope separately.
metrics.category: Four concepts each; descriptive only; report literal failures and alternatives.
metrics.poolIdeal: Shared union eight semantic top10 pools plus independently proposed graded reference candidates, never injected into rankings.
metrics.emptyIdeal: Return null for all-zero judged pool, report count; usefulness remains zero.
metrics.unknown: Publish missingness; no null coercion; conservative paired metric bounds plus resolved-only diagnostic, not sole decision basis.

uncertainty.comparisons: Seven primary configuration contrasts versus BGE-small/current. Four within-model context deltas, average context effect, and three difference-in-differences are predeclared explanatory analyses, not extra confirmation claims.
uncertainty.resample: Stratified concept cluster bootstrap: sample four concepts with replacement per category; preserve all eight configurations and paired scopes jointly in each draw.
intervals: 95% descriptive paired intervals for every contrast
99.2857142857% per-contrast intervals for seven primary contrasts (Bonferroni familywise view)
uncertainty.caution: Seven simultaneous primary contrasts, not eight independent winner claims. Explanatory context/interaction analyses are descriptive; do not promote a favorable subgroup to a new primary success claim. Only four fixed model packages are studied; average effects do not generalize to arbitrary models.

review.primary: All unique pooled judgments exactly once, source-backed, before unblinding.
review.overlap: Deterministic ceil(10% of actual deduplicated judgment pool), including independently proposed reference candidates; stratified category and scope, selected before grades. Compatible cross-scope reuse remains recorded. No fixed384 ceiling.
review.disputes: Every grade disagreement (including0/1 and2/3) and every opposite flag disagreement requires explicit adjudication. Unknowns stay unknown; unresolved means needs_adjudication, no final point conclusion.
review.userPacket: All unresolved grade or opposite-function flag disputes, including0/1 and2/3, plus preselected one concept per category; up to twelve concrete first-page examples, all remaining disputes linked in a complete appendix.
review.integrity: Validate ID coverage, legal grades, pointers, hashes and cross-scope consistency before unblinding.

decision.policy: Seven semantic configurations versus small/current, concept-balanced usefulness, uncertainty, category/opposite-function tradeoffs and cost. Name controls are separate diagnostics, not a test of later production lexical lookup. No automatic adoption.
hardValidity: Complete pinned corpus and identical candidate eligibility
No silent clipping or omitted roots
Semantic-only common filters and deterministic root-max aggregation; no lexical/alias tiers
decision.next: Retain baseline if evidence inconclusive; promising candidate merits explicit product decision, not tuning on fresh results.
